Lotus Sport's competition specification identifies the GT4 Supersport as a 2009 SRO-eligible 2-Eleven with a six-speed sequential gearbox, flat shift and automatic blip; the AC package name and six-speed sequential behavior agree.

claims.basis: Lotus Sport's competition specification identifies the GT4 Supersport as a 2009 SRO-eligible 2-Eleven with a six-speed sequential gearbox, flat shift and automatic blip; the AC package name and six-speed sequential behavior agree.

Lotus specifies a six-speed close-ratio gearbox. Lotus specifies a sequential six-speed gearbox. The specification describes push-pull sequential operation and the cockpit photo shows a competition wheel/shift control; it does not justify changing the real-car actuation to a simulator paddle assumption. A sequential gearbox has sequential selection rather than an H gate. The competition specification identifies a physical twin-plate clutch; launch use is the supported standing-start conclusion. Lotus explicitly specifies flat shift operation. Flat-shift operation is the documented automatic torque-interruption behavior. Manual blip is a downshift action, not an upshift action. Automatic blip is specified for downshifts, not upshifts. Throttle-lift is modeled for upshift technique in this record. The specification documents flat shift for upshifts, not a downshift cut. The documented system provides automatic blip, so manual blip is not the authentic driver action. Lotus explicitly specifies an auto-blip system. The inspected GT4 cockpit photograph shows a conventional open-top, flattened-rim competition wheel rather than a fixed-grip control-panel rim. No readout is visible on the wheel face; the cockpit instruments are separate. No wheel-mounted shift-light strip or lamps are visible in the inspected image. The photographed wheel is explicitly open-topped and the upper rim section is absent. The reviewed sources did not establish the remaining technique and wheel fields, which stay unknown in the real-car baseline: /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/clutch.
